synopsis: Fraunhofer IVI is identified as providing testing for agricultural and construction machinery in both Chapter 11 and the glossary [f8824, f16079, f16114]. Chapter 11 describes this testing as directly relevant to off-road machinery and also identifies research activity in this field [f8824, f8695]. The supporting institute page is classified as vendor evidence; the supplied facts give no costs, dates, quantitative results, or specific collision-mitigation validation capabilities [f8695, f8824, f16079, f16114].
